items.title: Vincent Pelote interviewed by Monk Rowe, Orlando, Florida, February 25, 2017
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] My name is Monk Rowe and we are in Orlando at the MLA conference, and I’m very happy to have Vincent Pelote with me today... [INTERVIEWEE] Thank you, Monk.

ctx.x: Vincent was interviewed in Orlando, Florida on February 25, 2017 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe and we are in Orlando at the MLA conference, and I’m very happy to have Vincent Pelote with me today, Director of Operations at the Institute of Jazz Studies at Rutgers. Welcome.
